connector.name: RPG Maker MV Ultimate MCP
connector.registryDescription: RPG Maker MV Ultimate: AI copilot to generate, edit and understand RPG Maker MV projects (MCP)
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package rpgmaker-mv-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the diegolopez0208 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: RPGMAKER_PROJECT_PATH
env.description: Absolute path to the RPG Maker MV project to edit (the folder with data/ and js/). The server starts without it; needed for real editing, or call set_project_path at runtime.

env.name: VISION_API_URL
env.description: Base URL of an OpenAI-compatible vision endpoint to enable analyze_image mode "ai" (e.g. https://api.openai.com or http://localhost:11434). Unset = vision disabled; every other tool works offline.

env.name: VISION_API_KEY
env.description: Bearer token for the vision endpoint (only sent when set).

env.name: VISION_MODEL
env.description: Vision model name to request (e.g. gpt-4o, llava). Defaults to meta/llama-3.2-90b-vision-instruct.

env.name: RPGMV_LEGACY_TOOLS
env.description: Set to 1 to also advertise the 101 legacy v4 tool names (they remain callable regardless of this flag).
